primary_endpoint: Open-label part: improvement of fibrosis based on liver biopsy (up to 72 or 120 weeks); double-blind part: liver histology at 72 weeks and a composite long-term outcome.
efficacy_outcome: Open-label fibrosis improvement percentages reported: 31.4%, 26.5%, 51.0%, 74.5%, and 41.2%. Double-blind endpoint results are expected in 2027.
safety_signal: In the open-label part, 1/154 participants had a serious adverse event; the deaths entry is listed as “154” in the source.
